title: Original Xbox: planned, and open to requests
body: The original Xbox is planned for OpenPak and not yet built. Its online era looks like the Wii and DS: no accounts, no push, and per-game rosters, so it will reuse the same service approach rather than a new one. Twenty-eight original Xbox titles can be requested from the catalogue today. We will not claim online play for any of them until a game has been played online on a real console.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
